name: XPlayer NodeDistributePlus permissionless DynamicBurnPool drains the XPL/USDT pair
summary: XPL.DynamicBurnPool moves XPL from the XPL/USDT PancakeSwap pair to DEAD and calls sync(), and is restricted to owner, staking, marketing and nodeShareAddress. nodeShareAddress is the NodeDistributePlus proxy, whose DynamicBurnPool(date, amount) forwards any caller's request within the day's burn cap with no caller check. The attacker bought almost all pair XPL with flash-loaned USDT, burned the day's remaining 3,078 XPL cap from the pair through NodeDistributePlus, and sold 57 XPL back against a near-zero XPL reserve for all pair USDT.

loss.notes: Exact USDT depletion of the XPL/USDT pair 0x9b0ff36de2fc477cda8e4468e0067322ae18ce70 in the single exploit transaction. The attacker's 217,118,901.83 USDT swap inputs and the 239.5M USDT flash loans are returned within the transaction and netted out; the 245,744.20 USDT paid to flash lenders does not reduce gross depletion, so the loss exceeds the 718,844.12 USDT attacker profit reported by BlockSec. The pair's XPL loss (694,171.88 to 57.41 XPL) is the same liquidity and is not added.

ageReset.description: Admin upgradeTo selected the NodeDistributePlus implementation whose DynamicBurnPool has no caller authorization (it also dropped the previous one-hour cooldown); it is the last Upgraded event before the exploit and the implementation the exploit trace delegatecalls.

sources.note: Lead from BlockSec (source-6). source-1: 77915282:2, from EOA 0x9df9a1d108ee9c667070514b9a238b724a86094f to attack contract 0x80bd723dc38a07952db40c1c2a45084714399bd9 (created by that EOA earlier in the same block, tx 0xc9296fdfd405cb96a5c1e100c367935a50df32c27f71961d8d9928241b396f59), calldata carries the string "2026-1-28". debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): nested flash loans of USDT; router 0x10ed43c718714eb63d5aa57b78b54704e256024e swaps 100 USDT and 217118801.830756075945725657 USDT into pair 0x9b0ff36de2fc477cda8e4468e0067322ae18ce70 (receipt logs 28, 37; XPL out logs 32, 39); the attack contract reads NodeDistributePlus proxy 0xb413271b84902c95f01015d58326dda59a747854 views 0x7fa08be8/0xcb26ee2f (dayTotalBurnedList/daytotalNeedBurnList("2026-1-28") = 3078e18/6156e18), then CALLs proxy DynamicBurnPool(string,uint256) 0xd9ccae68("2026-1-28", 3078e18), which delegatecalls implementation 0x15b1879ff6acc145300f7a204809473a9e158917 and CALLs XPL 0xc2c4ccde8948c693d0b04f8bad461e35a12f20b8 DynamicBurnPool(uint256) 0x1a1fddd5, which moves 3078e18 XPL pair->0x...dead (log 42) and calls pair.sync(); the attacker then sells 57.405756517287941415 XPL (log 51) for 218083490.143452801535655976 USDT (log 52). Verified sources (source-4): XPL.DynamicBurnPool requires msg.sender in {owner, staking, nodeShareAddress, marketingAddress}; NodeDistributePlus.DynamicBurnPool(date,_amount) is external nonReentrant and checks only _amount>0, daytotalNeedBurnList[date]>0, block.timestamp <= dayBurnTaskTimeList[date]+2 days and the cumulative cap, with no msg.sender check, so anyone holds the proxy's burn privilege. Fix: implementation 0x83d5a47c38fa1b15abfc5327a46c7e67d3b3a5f0 (Upgraded 77932620:77) adds require(isWhiteList[_msgSender()], "k000"). Admission: the privilege was reached through that missing check, not through any key; XPL ownership had been renounced at 77350024 (0x817515091c38b2fcc46d07a21987a3d52b831829b794a4249baf4d3d0c32c33a) and the attacker is not the proxy admin/owner 0xf6a972f1590cae74719f4c9c4c84f192c268b53c. Age: Etherscan getLogs Upgraded (topic 0xbc7cd75a...) on the proxy, blocks 0..99999999: 7 events: c1823c18 (75133160), 94a08406 (75354599), 715393ea (75355645), cd7f3e07 (77826594), e3bd9bbe (77827431), 15b1879f (77842820:48:210, source-2, from admin 0xf6a972f1..., upgradeTo), 83d5a47c (77932620, post-exploit). eth_getStorageAt EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a1... = 0x15b1879f at 77915281 and 0xe3bd9bbe at 77842819. Diff of verified sources: e3bd9bbe (SHA-256 1a94aee5416a04451ae269de1bfca3ebe6abc73feb8510d17a52b2513468160a) differs from 15b1879f only by the commented-out one-hour k003 cooldown in DynamicBurnPool; both lack caller authorization. Implementation 15b1879f created at 77842622:28 by 0xaeba1091204c9c5286388700a6a059432c92a327 (project deployer that also deployed the fix): eth_getCode empty at 77842621; keccak(runtime) 0x316b57e162cae9f1bb2db67489599a4743c90bf879f4190d33994fbadf094070 (17525 bytes) at 77842622 and 77915281. Proxy runtime keccak 0x41dd92e5833d35147b49c14530921bfaf7ca5323b671498fa55b03609f2923af (1402 bytes) at 75133160 and 77915281, empty at 75133159; created 75133160:132 by 0xf6a972f1. Configuration: proxy txlist (5387 txs to 77932620) owner calls before the exploit are setTimeHelperContract (77827640) and setDayTotalNeedBurn(6156e18) (77827853, 0xae7573a23001cef064a977714f3ea9e8351121296ae01a3dfa8d754a0ca6f6dc, sets dayBurnTaskTimeList["2026-1-28"] = 1769567875), both before the upgrade; the daily cap is the intended keeper schedule and only bounds exposure. XPL owner txlist: setTNodeDistributePlusAddress(0xb413271b...) at 75133457:79, no later privilege change. The upgrade at 77842820 is therefore the latest reset; codeAgeSeconds = 1769607227 - 1769574610 = 32617. First exercise: eth_getLogs XPL AutoEvent(string,uint256) topic 0xcf4c5f9fe32d18422b4ab8a4f18f01f92679f132e84297c6f59a6023f127f112, blocks 77826000..77940000: 13 "_autoBurnPoolByOwner" emissions; callTracer shows 2 by the admin EOA calling the proxy directly (77831868, 77842850) and 10 via Chainlink Automation registry 0xdc21e279934ff6721cadfdd112dafb3261f09a2c -> forwarder 0xf9744915491471a79fcd8653a50ec714d8855ff3 -> project keeper 0xd434fd58a610fc794a5857521ce57374fab50679 (created by the admin at 77834093) at ~8000-block intervals; source-1 is the first and only emission by a third party and no emission follows before the fix.
